maddeler.e:
نخص (form I)
# نَخُصُّ (naḵuṣṣu) /na.xusˤ.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of خَصَّ (ḵaṣṣa)
# نُخَصُّ (nuḵaṣṣu) /nu.xasˤ.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of خَصَّ (ḵaṣṣa)
# نَخُصَّ (naḵuṣṣa) /na.xusˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of خَصَّ (ḵaṣṣa)
# نُخَصَّ (nuḵaṣṣa) /nu.xasˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunct
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
